title: Acquisition by Cursor
description: Continue was acquired by Cursor. The team stated their mission to ensure developers are amplified rather than automated continues in the work ahead. The open-source codebase remains freely available.

title: Codex CLI 0.147.0 - Agent Plugins, Conversation Organization, and MCP Protocol Update
description: This release includes Agent Plugin System with support for installing portable plugins across catalogs, persistent conversation organization with manually ordered sections, automatic approval capabilities via --approve-for-me flag, import for Cursor-managed skills and sync of imported Claude and Cursor conversations, updated support for MCP 2026-07-28 protocol with paginated discovery, cached web search, and multiple bug fixes including security enhancements.

title: Copilot Code Review Effort Levels GA
description: GitHub Copilot's code review effort levels reached general availability, bringing enhanced code review capabilities to users.

title: Impact Dashboard ROI Section
description: The Copilot impact dashboard now includes a return on investment section to help teams measure value.

title: Usage Metrics API Expansion
description: Usage metrics API expanded to track agent app activity, providing better insights into Copilot usage patterns.

title: MCP Allowlists in Enterprise Managed Settings
description: MCP allowlists introduced in enterprise managed settings, giving organizations more control over Copilot configurations.

title: Kimi K3 Model Availability
description: Kimi K3 model became available in GitHub Copilot, expanding model options for users.

title: Stacked PRs Feature
description: Devin (formerly Windsurf) now automatically creates stacks of small, independently reviewable pull requests when handling large tasks. The feature manages rebasing, conflict resolution, and CI verification automatically, addressing the problem of massive AI-generated PRs that have increased review burden by 91% according to Faros AI research.

title: Kimi K3 Model Integration
description: The Kimi K3 model launched in both Devin Desktop and Devin CLI. It delivers competitive coding performance on real-world engineering tasks, approaching frontier-level performance by surpassing GPT-5.5 and falling only behind Opus, Fable, and GPT-5.6 Sol. Notably, it's the only open-source model achieving this level of performance.

title: Google Workspace Plugins
description: Cursor added Google Workspace plugins, integrating the AI coding environment with Google's productivity tools.

title: Copilot Cloud Agent Reasoning Customization
description: Users can now customize the reasoning level for Copilot cloud agent, allowing more control over AI behavior.

title: Enterprise Team Specialization
description: Enterprise team specialization for managed settings was released, providing enhanced team management capabilities.

title: Copilot Automations with Comment Triggers
description: Copilot automations can now be triggered with comments, enabling more interactive workflows.

title: iPad Support
description: Cursor is now available on iPad, extending AI coding capabilities to mobile tablet devices.

title: Cursor Start
description: New Cursor Start feature was announced, providing enhanced onboarding and project initialization capabilities.
